F-C5-6.sample_space: The shader samples texture(distance_texture, UV). UV is the unmodified original Sprite2D texture coordinate; the R*S*R inverse hierarchy changes vertices, not texture UVs. There is no world-position-to-UV conversion in the inspected emission.
F-C5-6.clip_numbers: Expanded material has no outer_distance declaration/discard. At age 8 erode=0 disables erode discard, and dissolve=0 is below all four thresholds. Even hypothetical clamped distance=1 would survive: 1 < erode is false for erode<1; erode=1 intentionally discards all pixels. Root-only outer_distance=1 at age 8 also cannot discard any normalized distance.
F-C5-6.conclusion: Neither named shader rule can cut the expanding sprites at the original canvas edge in this build. The straight 511-pixel rendered plateau is real evidence, but its cause is not established by these permitted sources. A crop/viewport or outside-project mismatch remains an untested possibility; export/replay.py was not read.

alternatives.a: Bands 0 and 1 have not reached their shared 5/6 removal threshold. They survive together, not band 0 surviving a removed band 1.
alternatives.b: Every dark sprite matches its corresponding paint sprite in erode/dissolve/outer_distance and transform. Stationary and expanding representations use different schedules, but this difference is shared by their painted layers, not specific to the dark duplicates.
alternatives.c: PeakDark is hidden at age 30; excluded by actual headless trace.

F-C5-7.conclusion: No evidence selects the proposed dark-only schedule defect. All-four equality is false because the original stationary residue and expanding representations intentionally use different curves. Unifying them changes lap-2 behavior beyond a dark-duplicate fix; rendered causal attribution remains unresolved.

residue.denominator_note: The exporter targets 20% of original peak artwork (41951 px), not maximum coverage over the animated expansion. The supplied bake rows give 8211/72040=11.3989%, whereas 12.7% uses a different denominator. Future tuning must state the chosen peak denominator.

build_decision: No production patch: the stipulated clipping cause and dark-only mismatch are contradicted by the emitted source and actual headless trace. Do not invent a causal fix or silently replace the literal all-layer equality requirement with pairwise equality.
procedure_concerns: The initial SPEC excerpt included sections 2 through 6 outside the requested sections. Input asset reads required to build the explicitly requested real-kit proof consumed referenced kit files; no unrelated source was inspected.
